season.name: Summer
season.line: Labor without Sabbath becomes bondage, however fruitful it looks.

movement.name: The Long Day
movement.line: Endurance is the work of wisdom.

days.t: Parched by day, chilled by night
x: I was parched with heat by day, and [chilled] with frost by night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.

days.t: The sun shall not strike you by day
x: The Lord shall keep thee: the Lord is thy shelter upon thy right hand.
The sun shall not burn thee by day, neither the moon by night.

days.t: He gives power to the faint
x: And now, hast thou not known? hast thou not heard? the eternal God, the God that formed the ends of the earth, shall not hunger, nor be weary, and there is no searching of his understanding.
He gives strength to the hungry, and sorrow to them that are not suffering.

days.t: The burden of the day and the scorching heat
x: saying, ‘These, the last, worked one hour, and you made them equal to us, the ones having borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat.’
Bear one another’s burdens and thus you⁺ will fulfill the law of Christ.

days.t: Do not grow weary in well-doing
x: Now you⁺, brothers, should not grow weary [in] well-doing.
